description: The only native code milestone 5A loads. It runs exclusively inside a supervised Electron utility process and depends on nothing beyond Node-API and the C standard library, so one payload per target keeps working across Electron upgrades.

linux-arm64.blockedBy: No Linux ARM64 build host is provisioned; cross-building is external work and is never filled in from another target's bytes.

mac-arm64.blockedBy: No macOS ARM64 build host is provisioned; the Apple toolchain and signing identity are the named milestone-5 external blockers.

win-x64.blockedBy: No Windows x64 build host is provisioned; cross-building is external work and is never filled in from another target's bytes.

win-arm64.blockedBy: No Windows ARM64 build host is provisioned; cross-building is external work and is never filled in from another target's bytes.
